svg.text: Canonica: IGUAL = Sm(0,5,10,15) - mintermos isolados na diagonal do mapa K,

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: sem laco possivel; a simplificacao vem do fatoramento:

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: IGUAL = (A1'P1' + A1P1)(A0'P0' + A0P0) = (A1 xnor P1)(A0 xnor P0)

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: Forma usada no circuito (74HC86 tem saida totem-pole; 74HC266 e dreno aberto):

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: DIFERENTE = (A1 xor P1) + (A0 xor P0) -> U3A, U3B (74HC86) + U2B (74HC32)

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: IGUAL = DIFERENTE' -> U1B (74HC04)

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: H = FALHA' . IGUAL -> U1A (74HC04) + U5A (74HC08)

svg.text: A1e = A1.H A0e = A0.H B1e = B1.H B0e = B0.H -> U4A..U4D (74HC08)

svg.text: Com H = 0 o somador recebe 0 + 0. ALARME nao entra em H (sem realimentacao).

svg.text: Carry: o carry do estagio 0 (A0 = B0 = 1) entra no estagio 1; o do estagio 1

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: entra no estagio 2 e aparece em S2 (3 + 3 = 0110). Estagios 2 e 3 recebem 0 + 0,

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: logo S3 = Cout = 0 nesta faixa. Por isso S2 precisa ser preservado.

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: 5. LEDS DE STATUS EXCESSO = S3 + S2 (total > 3)

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: FALHA IGUAL EXCESSO | CONF ALARME LIB | obs

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: 0 0 0 | 1 0 0 | divergencia, S = 0

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: 0 0 1 | x x x | impossivel: H = 0 => S = 0

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: 1 0 0 | 0 1 0 | codigo invalido

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: 1 0 1 | x x x | impossivel

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: 1 1 0 | 0 1 0 | invalido prevalece

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: 1 1 1 | x x x | impossivel

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: CONFERIR = FALHA'.DIFERENTE -> U5B ALARME = FALHA + EXCESSO -> U2D

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
